method.sample: CPI releases 2024-01..2026-10 with FX_IDC:XAUUSD 30m data (release bar opens 08:30 ET)
method.surprise: actual minus consensus MoM (0.1 pp steps); primary core, secondary headline; hot > 0, cool < 0
method.outcomes: R30 = bar 1 close, R4h = bar 8 close, Rday = close of the 16:30 NY bar; all vs release-bar open, %
method.tests: hot minus cool mean (1.96 x Welch (unpooled) SE); share moving with the surprise (Wilson); OLS slope per 0.1 pp; the 4h slope is post-hoc (only the 30m slope was pre-registered)
method.rules: B follow bar 1, C trade surprise after 30m, D trade surprise at release (upper bound, not executable); entries and exits at 30m closes; costs USD per oz round trip

limitations: n = 32 releases with MoM figures (33 for rule B) split into hot / in-line / cool; most bounds are wide.
Consensus figures come from secondary sources (polls quoted in news, or calendars), not an official series.
Fills at 30m bar closes ignore slippage inside the bar; rule D (from the release open) is not executable.
The delayed 2025-10-24 and 2026-02-13 releases are kept.
Generic rule backtests for illustration; not trading advice.
